spec_match.rationale: The practical shape of the contract: a media-query listener starting a transition, with per-crossing frame-delay measurement.

interactive.rationale: Slider drags and the ten-sweep button both produce crossings (6 recorded in this run); clear resets; facts tiles update.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises timing every crossing — delivered, with direction per row.

edge_cases.rationale: No-transition rows surfaced, 40-crossing cap, mixture-vs-consistent interpretation guidance in the detail copy.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite result (4/2) matches what this page measures on this build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Live sweep measured 6/6 crossings one iteration late with ~16.7ms deltas and the page reported 0 of 6 same-iteration with the correct pre-fix explanation; console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: crossings-measured asserts the literal true; asserting timed>0 after a sweep would catch a broken arm().

design_system.rationale: Facts tiles, bars and table all on CSS variables; range input given 44px min-height.

accessibility.rationale: Slider labelled with the breakpoint value, output aria-live, iframe titled, focus visible.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at 360px; the frame sits in an overflow-x wrapper so dragging wide widths cannot stretch the page.

openQuestions.title: Re-measure crossings on stable Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: All 6 live crossings measured 1 iteration late on this 153.0.8010.12 headless build — consistent with the sibling pages and the 2 failing conformance assertions. Re-run on stable 153 and refresh this critique when the aligned behaviour is observable.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. Slider and sweep both drive real crossings; the page displayed the all-late result honestly with the right interpretation.
